purpose: Test whether the provider-caused part of run 40326110478's 14 failed cells reproduces. This run lost 3,640 s to transport plus one 1,800 s timeout across eleven cells, and eleven of its fifteen non-passes carry a provider entry. Only the cells whose stall could plausibly have decided them are re-measured.

admission.rule: AGENTS.md:11 — a declared re-measurement is the only way an already-graded cell may be measured again, and it never replaces the verdict it re-measures. Each cell below carries a canonical failed verdict from run 40326110478, so none is recovered: each receives exactly one extra attempt under the same candidate, provider, budget, grader and composition.
admission.class: variance check — the cell's own frozen evidence carries an explicit provider failure (transport or model-invocation timeout) consuming at least 10% of that cell's declared agent budget

threshold.declaredBeforeDispatch: cumulative duration of model-failure entries (reason transport or a timeout) divided by the cell's own effectiveAgentTimeoutSec, at least 0.10
threshold.whyThisThreshold: It is the same number the previous recheck used, so the rule is not fitted to this run's outcome. It separates a stall that could decide a cell from incidental noise inside a 900-5400 s budget.

knownRisks.recurrence: The previous recheck reproduced the stall in three of four cells. A repeat here is the likeliest outcome and would show the provider condition is persistent rather than a one-off.
knownRisks.varianceIsNotCausation: A flip shows the verdict is unstable under these provider conditions; it does not by itself attribute the original failure.
